children: H.B. Fuller reported third-quarter 2026 results with revenue rising to $938.18M and diluted EPS of $1.44, as net income climbed to $79.18M versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Net revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income including non-controlling interest”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share attributable to H.B. Fuller common stockholders”.
Revenue growth was driven by pricing gains (pricing +7.4% in the quarter; +3.7% YTD) that offset lower volumes, resulting in net revenue up 5.2% for the quarter and 3.1% YTD.
Pricing execution and momentum across core channels—Hygiene, Engineering and Building—supported revenue and segment EBITDA improvement.
Gross margin expanded by roughly 120–160 basis points aided by restructuring actions and synergies from recent acquisitions, improving segment EBITDA margins.
Company continues integration of acquisitions (ND entities, GEM), is rolling out Project ONE ERP and pursuing restructuring and footprint optimization through 2028.
